deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: This setting controls whether destructive deletion of the resource is prevented. Because it can protect the resource from accidental or unauthorized destruction, it is a security-relevant lifecycle control.

egress_policy_name.description: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.
egress_policy_name.rationale: Identifies the target service perimeter for the resource and is environment-specific configuration rather than a generic security control enforced by the Policy Deployment Engine.

resource.description: A GCP resource that is inside of the service perimeter.
resource.rationale: Specifies a workload-specific GCP resource inside the perimeter. The Policy Deployment Engine should not prescribe which individual resources an organisation must include.
